en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 7. And from the previous chain from Jabir from Abi al-Tufayl from Ali (a.s.)

who said: ‘There is no God except Allah’ and his or her grades are not elevated. He or she will continue to scale all heights. None of his (or her) sins shall be questioned. And for each of his sins equal number of good deeds would be given and he would be satisfied.
